prs.title: Node: Fix core filesystem, process, and web API behavior
prs.head: b4845ff854a6d8b082d776157dc4550edb5ef257
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real guest libc chmod/fsync operations; fd-read nonblocking admission, cancellation by exact pending Promise, independent loop reference state. JS fixes negative errno/partial writes, child PATH/cwd and EOF but those public policies are not native binding implementations.
historicalDisposition: Extract/adapt genuine native owners behind the new fs/stream bindings, considering later ownership-corrected descendants.
Retain file/write/stdin/PATH/exit/URL/Buffer regressions.
Replace handmade public APIs and alternative public URL/WebStreams libraries with whole Node modules/dependencies. Do not transplant the entire bootstrap/bundle.

prs.title: Node: Pin LTS target and restore upstream suite
prs.head: 1a99195b017167ff4c51d612195582c73778abd6
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Conformance/build infrastructure: coherent target manifest feeds CLI and process identity; source hashes and native/browser/guest runners retain real flags, environment, timeouts, artifact identities and unsupported/error statuses. Removes false Linux/V8/libuv/module-ABI metadata.
historicalDisposition: Reuse archive pin/coherence, native reference and honest per-host result accounting, including later1611 integrity corrections.
Verify the target/source/native reference against official sources separately; this audit does not validate the release designation.
Replace monolithic import-stripping bootstrap assembly with the new shared module environment as needed.

prs.title: Node: Correct text codec boundaries and EOF
prs.head: 90180c605b92bfc45aa565c627b1197ee35987f3
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: No new native primitive. Uses existing native decodeUtf8 only for validated complete non-shared spans, with JS state machines, intrinsic byte-view access, surrogate replacement and stdin EOF flush.
historicalDisposition: Keep malformed/split UTF8/UTF16, BOM/fatal, encodeInto, view brands and stdin EOF tests.
Execute upstream encoding/StringDecoder modules and implement their native transcoder/buffer state needs.
Do not retain these handwritten public classes as the new module implementation.

prs.title: Node: Restore assertion matchers and deep comparisons
prs.head: 977351ed76181a247864c5b67800b99538de3722
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Native Promise brand uses CheckedUnwrapStatic and JS::IsPromiseObject without calling then/getters. Existing genuine native Error/Proxy brands are forwarded. Byte comparisons/non-index property filtering supply internal services in JS; they are not one coherent shared Node environment yet.
historicalDisposition: Reuse pinned original modules and tests through the new shared builtin loader.
Carry engine brand/byte/property primitives only after their actual realm/security/GC contracts fit.

Replace local AssertionError/errors/validators/primordials/inspection substitutes with their upstream modules and genuine backend; disclose/remove diagnostic source adaptation rather than count it as full parity.

prs.title: Node: Finalize eval shutdown and uncaught main failures
prs.head: 39d6e685ccb0568697a8f294b908d22b8c4166ea
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real SpiderMonkey shell hook after job/timer/I/O draining and rejection reporting calls a private JS finalizer and returns process status. Explicit failure flag preserves primitive thrown values.
historicalDisposition: Adapt shell completion/fatal result handling to the actual upstream process/bootstrap contract.
Retain eval/CJS/ESM, unset/cleared exitCode, pending work and primitive-throw cases.
Consider later1616/1619 lifecycle successors before extracting this early hook.

prs.title: Node: Preserve descriptor cursors for positioned I/O
prs.head: 74f638fc6d8729bd007bce2f67a432c275773d0b
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real libc pread/pwrite binding with exact signed64 BigInt/safe-number offsets, bounds checking and no OFD cursor mutation. Count/-errno seam is not itself Node fs internalBinding request/wrapper/error/async contract.
historicalDisposition: Adapt positioned I/O backend behind whole upstream fs modules; retain64-bit offset and cursor/pipe error tests.
Replace public overload/error/callback implementations.
Review later backing/borrowing/GC ownership corrections; old ArrayBuffer-only seam is not full current shared/growable buffer support.

prs.title: Node: Track Response consumption and clone body streams
prs.head: 26c78f2d95c3622d4eceacfda1ab561800587fdb
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Exposes genuine SpiderMonkey serialize/deserialize graph cloning as cloneValue for independent stream chunk graphs. Actual tee/cancel state comes from third-party streams. Remaining changes are public/middle-layer JS semantics rather than a new transport backend.
historicalDisposition: Keep repeated-consumption, lock/disturbance, independent clone bytes, snapshots and cancellation tests.
Use Node Blob and the pinned Node bundled Fetch/WebStreams graph with genuine backend support.
Do not transplant the alternate stream private-slot adapter; review later clone/transfer/GC ownership work before backend extraction.

prs.title: POSIX: Preserve wide offsets in resident filesystems
prs.head: bd11508e1c0d373bbdae0d60a6a8b0e679645a20
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Reads compare wide offsets before narrowing to wasm32 usize; writes reject unrepresentable offsets/EFBIG; export reader avoids wrapping. Independent of Node. Current-main rootfs has equivalent checked conversions after refactoring, while tmpfs still retains the old cast-before-bound-check source pattern.
historicalDisposition: Retain wide-offset/EOF/no-corruption/cursor regressions for both backends.
Do not transplant old rootfs source or duplicate its now-present fixes.
Inspect/adapt the remaining tmpfs change in current code, preserving current quota refund and set-ID semantics; owning ABI review still applies.

prs.title: Tests: Preserve complete Node upstream source inputs
prs.head: f84ff24293d7b917b17feb258e74acad07a0dcf2
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Conformance infrastructure only: typed entry hashes include directories/modes/links; VFS copies all source entries and preflight probes them. Browser immutable image input is cached as plain bytes and copied independently per guest.
historicalDisposition: Carry all-entry source integrity and full fixture preservation into the new importer/harness, adapted to current VFS/browser quiet policy.
Keep exact artifact manifests and failure/unsupported accounting.
Do not count copied lib sources in a test image or historical5147case baseline as current module implementation/conformance.

prs.title: Node: Apply connection defaults to real socket attempts
prs.head: 60c3ce9b540b73723fccdf15318f94b2df1e7b93
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real getaddrinfo/inet_ntop lookup, IPv4/IPv6 nonblocking connect/local bind, SO_ERROR outcome, getsockname/getpeername and owned-fd cleanup. Promise identifies pending connect cancellation. Guest kernel/runtime fixes IPv6 wildcard source address while preserving bound port. Interfaces are private Promise/fd records, not Node TCPWrap/GetAddrInfoReqWrap bindings.
historicalDisposition: Adapt genuine operations/owners to upstream Node wrappers/request objects/callback timing, using later ownership-corrected code.
Keep native-peer multi-address/bind/timeout/abort/error/cleanup tests.

Replace handmade public net/dns option/result/attempt policy with whole upstream modules. Remaining fabricated dns.resolve records in the old bootstrap are not fixed by this PR and must not be carried as support.

prs.title: Node: Separate public globals from embedding utilities
prs.head: 8181022ff8206ac54d964ad9f2caaffdb6ac7d01
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: JavaScript engine-adapter boundary captures real shell utilities before removing shell globals; prepareGlobalScope deletes non-ECMA/nonpublic shell names while closures retain I/O/worker/shutdown functions. No new native C++/kernel operation.
prs.historicalDisposition: Keep safe capture/removal mechanism after loader design review. Replace/manual descriptor policy with upstream bootstrap mechanisms where applicable. Do not use non-enumerability as the privacy mechanism for privileged internal bindings.

prs.title: Node: Load file entrypoints through the native module graph
prs.head: f0eaf9086765e269dd7257c327e7e11e2a03c5af
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: SpiderMonkey ScriptPrivate origin registration for compiled CJS wrappers; real native import() submission, engine parse/link/cycles/TLA; resolve-only metadata hook avoids executing CJS during import.meta.resolve; file entry returns to owning jobs/I/O/timers loop and exits unresolved graph with status13.
prs.historicalDisposition: Salvage compiled-script identity, native module graph and host event-loop handoff behind Node ModuleWrap/contextify-style bindings. Replace custom public resolution/cache/synthetic namespace policy with upstream Node loader/internal modules. Do not import the old loader wholesale.

prs.title: Node: Capture call sites from engine saved frames
prs.head: 3dff86662e9b3e33df1df60065a08c5012ebbb54
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Actual saveStack source IDs/function names/coordinates; C++ compile-options first-line support for wrapped CJS and ESM public sourceURL without changing native registry keys.
prs.historicalDisposition: Retain actual saved-frame/source-origin capabilities behind upstream internalBinding(util).getCallSites; replace public wrapper with whole upstream util. Preserve actual engine identity and recorded source-map limits; do not hardcode a two-frame skip into a different wrapper architecture.

prs.title: Node: Stop fatal exits before draining live work
prs.head: e667d0953d34bd61ba557c5aad092f58e6736843
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Engine preserves thrown timer/ESM failures, checks pending rejections at actual microtask checkpoints, stops draining native I/O/timers after fatal failure and reaches one finalizer instead of waiting forever on live handles.
prs.historicalDisposition: Carry actual pending-exception/checkpoint/fatal-loop-stop capabilities; put policy and hook dispatch in upstream process modules. Reconcile later callback/uncaught recovery owners before reusing early hardcoded report/exit branches.

prs.title: Node: Back TCP listeners and half-close with real sockets
prs.head: 0945a0f1378038068c347b5df538471d1325210a
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real POSIX nonblocking socket/bind/listen/accept; FD_CLOEXEC and close-on-error ownership; asynchronous Accept watches; SHUT_WR; per-operation referenced state by actual promise/fd.
prs.historicalDisposition: Retain socket semantics through a reviewed current native owner, expose Node tcp_wrap/stream_wrap request/handle contracts, and execute whole upstream net/stream logic. Replace the handwritten public Server/Socket and do not transplant bare-fd Promise API as the final binding interface.

prs.title: Node: Preserve exit-listener status and fatal diagnostics
prs.head: 3a36145e0375b0f2d901d5a85091840d14054402
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: C++ saves/restores the actual pending exception around a status query, reports original diagnostic and preserves validated Node status including explicit zero rather than letting standalone-shell reporter override it.
prs.historicalDisposition: Carry exception preservation and final native status/teardown mechanism. Move public exit emission/fatal policy into upstream process/bootstrap modules. Adapt the native query to a genuine process-owned status contract rather than retain an arbitrary public JS finalizer protocol.

prs.title: Node: Enforce TCP server connection limits
prs.head: d2fb64061ea9f9b50e756a9622595e46b2209b79
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: No new native binding. Existing accept/address/close primitives are used to account live accepted connections, emit endpoint records and close excess descriptors in finally.
prs.historicalDisposition: Keep unchanged upstream connection-limit/drop cases, actual endpoint/descriptor assertions and C-peer fixtures. Let upstream net.js own maxConnections/drop policy; supply accurate accept/endpoints/close and resource accounting beneath it.

prs.title: Node: Preserve timer lifetime, cancellation and refresh
prs.head: d005cc6a1be679f6ecaa7ec26311c39f4cc137b5
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Native monotonicTime from SpiderMonkey TimeStamp and event-loop referenced-work check; JS scheduler separates deadlines from reference state, queues cancellable callbacks and permits microtask checkpoints between entered callbacks.
prs.historicalDisposition: Keep real clock and backend liveness/wakeup capabilities. Execute whole upstream timers and internal/timers and implement their timers/task_queue bindings. Replace custom Timeout/Immediate/Promise timers, warnings/promisify and duplicate deadline heap policy; avoid two schedulers owning the same public lifecycle.

prs.title: Node: Run synchronous child processes through POSIX pipes
prs.head: 9254e99aab3c7aba2ed4ae96e20e2f0a2a752d9c
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real synchronous POSIX child controller interleaves pipe I/O with wait/reap without pumping parent JS, monotonic timeout/maxBuffer/signals, RAII pipe/child cleanup, only parent endpoint nonblocking, close-on-exec and stdio-fd alias avoidance; real credentials/setsid; correct -e argv binding.
prs.historicalDisposition: Retain native child/pipe/credential/CLI mechanisms after reviewing successor ownership fixes. Implement upstream spawn_sync.spawn(options)/process_wrap/pipe_wrap contracts and use whole child_process modules for public validation/options/errors. Replace custom JS normalization and Linux-numbered errno map with authoritative guest error binding.

prs.title: Node: Enforce socket inactivity deadlines
prs.head: bde15b2302d1127b8452692eaeeb3f14fde5fcd2
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Genuine pending-write byte count from each native Write watch buffer.size()-offset. JS metadata is tied to one captured descriptor state and retired on close rather than reading a reused fd; real read/write activity refreshes unreferenced deadlines.
prs.historicalDisposition: Reuse actual write-progress accounting behind Node-compatible StreamBase/TCP handle properties and callbacks. Let upstream net.js/internal stream helpers implement timeout policy and constructors. Keep private owner/generation authority, not a mutable public _handle metadata object, as the source of truth.

prs.title: Node: Add native SQLite, FIPS and TTY foundations
prs.head: d210a21f8fe580bb8926bd052abf5d2328103708
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real ncrypto FIPS state/generation; native constructible TTY and init-before-fd admission; SQLite statement LRU/GC/connection ownership.
prs.historicalDisposition: High backend value. Reuse native owners after contract review; replace public SQLite/crypto wrappers with upstream modules/native binding exports.

prs.title: Node: Extend Promise, DNS, TCP and crypto compatibility
prs.head: 5bd3bd32938986aa40e0b03a36b0c429b3de4d81
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: OpenSSL provider MAC names; c-ares resolver fallback reconfiguration; accepted TCP capabilities/listener admission; engine Promise identity/observer channels and private microtasks.
prs.historicalDisposition: High shared-backend value. Carry final coherent DNS/TCP/Promise owners, including1662 listener restoration; replace helper splicing/private lifecycle dispatch with full upstream internal consumers.

prs.title: Node: Extend spawn, Fetch, Worker and benchmark foundations
prs.head: 3087652d4f98f679b06c988fa49a01e2883f9f0d
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real Worker warning CLI/execArgv/env parsing reaches child bootstrap; actual histogram/clock/clone/V8 dependencies. Timeout/cancel paths consume real timers/processes/streams but are higher-level JS orchestration.
prs.historicalDisposition: Keep full internal sources and reusable Worker startup/CLI owners. Replace custom child_process/Worker/Undici public algorithms as full upstream modules activate; retain their error/order/cancellation obligations.

prs.title: Node: Extend native stream and TLS certificate handling
prs.head: 952a3f4b85a271bb15eef02c9d039d03c9b9c4ee
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Actual TCP/TTY native string writes, TTY ShutdownWrap and OpenSSL peer-certificate/legacy material conversion with owned bytes.
prs.historicalDisposition: High StreamBase/TTY/X509 backend value. Reconcile native shapes/lifetimes with upstream bindings; replace custom TLSSocket methods and selected dispatch helpers.

prs.title: Node: Own source-map caches and backing snapshots
prs.head: 05087555fd0b1456ed1a3160e7408c64394d6e73
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Rooted CJS sourceURL/sourceMappingURL capture before execution; real current-runtime ArrayBuffer allocation census and allocator byte sizes, not process.memoryUsage/RSS/V8 heap support.
prs.historicalDisposition: Reuse compiler metadata and needed observation capabilities. Replace local source-map dependency maps/private-symbol substitutions with full upstream modules and correct shared bindings.

prs.title: Node: Own assertion sources and parser retirement
prs.head: 853f7702bd806603e2d416fdfcc2f9c967c9f772
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Actual SpiderMonkey caller script/PC/source capture; llhttp Reset/Release with deferred Free/Close preserving active frame/input, list membership and publication rollback.
prs.historicalDisposition: High parser lifecycle value; source capture useful but diagnostic parity partial. Carry real native mechanics with later UTF8/AsyncReset fixes; replace selected assertion/parser orchestration with upstream internals.

prs.title: Node: Connect FIPS state and diagnostic consumers
prs.head: 4ff3fb09a49bb0faf195d1b416986da9108080bd
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real ncrypto FIPS mutation/generation, process/Worker ownership gate and locked error queue; ScriptSource UTF8 offset decoding.
prs.historicalDisposition: Reuse native FIPS/error and source decoding; keep full reporters. Replace handwritten crypto public installer; forced startup/config/provider admission and serializer remain prerequisites.

prs.title: Restore Node listener and public TTY foundations
prs.head: cceda903aa26a4968fe8fd683c5a688734ed0667
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Restores missing matching listener engine dispatcher/binding, successful-listen read registration, accepted-fd rollback and callback scope; unwraps actual TTY shutdown request packet.
prs.historicalDisposition: Strong recent example of desired whole-module direction. Reuse tty_wrap/StreamBase/listener owners behind shared bindings; carry with1655 and subsequent fixes, not isolated cherry-pick.

prs.title: Preserve Node Promise and queued socket ownership
prs.head: c17c1ee7180194cbb70562b32f7bc0d7f6c10ddd
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real rooted engine Promise-parent channel; TCP connect/read/write registration, ordered queued/zero-byte writes, failed-connect cancellation and callback retirement; DEBUG-only nursery release-build correction.
prs.historicalDisposition: High Promise/TCP foundation value. Reconcile final owner interfaces with upstream async_hooks/net; public Promise registry remains missing. Replace Fetch facade; retain ordering/identity failures.

prs.title: Node: Connect SQLite extensions and core resource policies
prs.head: b17352a6c379ca67dc7cd20ee8e97c586a97a393
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Actual SQLite connection extension permission/enable/load lifetime; native Brotli/Zstd init errors; real legacy watcher event interest/retirement; own-field env descriptor semantics.
prs.historicalDisposition: High backend correctness/security value. Expose proper native SQLite/env bindings; retain side-module format/ABI/permission and throwing error-setter obligations rather than carrying bespoke public JS wholesale.

prs.title: Node: Preserve HTTP and TLS resource lifetimes
prs.head: 4ef78a500868092e2e026d56cd87a9e570329280
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: HTTP native AsyncReset/resource/frame/provider ownership and per-callback task checkpoints; deferred parser retirement; TLS real SSL read/write interest and input/output progress.
prs.historicalDisposition: High HTTP/TLS/AsyncWrap value. Carry real lifecycle/event-interest mechanisms; use complete upstream HTTP/bootstrap orchestration and normal binding contracts. Preserve early stdio/Socket ordering constraint.

prs.title: Node: Connect source maps and core metadata owners
prs.head: 6e14e85198334c371c74ad55ed664dca78cea5df
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Actual ncrypto curve enumeration; five separate engine Promise observations/AsyncWrap identity admission and settled-once state; real private source-map cache for explicit call-site mapping.
prs.historicalDisposition: High engine/provider value. Wire complete shared Promise-hook registry and upstream crypto/util/Undici modules. Retain real identity/cancellation/source-position requirements; replace helper assembly.

prs.title: Node: Connect filesystem checks, HTTP timing and guest groups
prs.head: 5f19f5f1c61cc80adb8e39e1f8470b497f34e9c8
prs.historicalBackendAssessment: Real supplementary-group syscall snapshots/effective-GID inclusion and native error/array publication; existing FS access queue and actual HTTP clock/observer events consumed.
prs.historicalDisposition: Narrow credentials backend useful. fs/HTTP sections should become redundant under whole upstream modules. Keep API-absence and timing-order obligations; expose GetGroups through upstream credentials binding.
